name: gui-input
description: Keyboard/mouse injection on Wayland+X11 via ydotool (kernel uinput). type text, key combos (ctrl+c, alt+f4), click/move by pixel. Fails fast with setup hints when ydotool/ydotoold are absent.
use_when: driving the desktop GUI — typing, shortcuts, clicks

args.name: backends
args.description: Report ydotool installed + daemon running + setup hint.

args.name: key <combo>
args.description: Combo like ctrl+c, alt+f4, Return. Validated names.

notes: Setup: sudo dnf install ydotool && systemctl --user enable --now ydotoold
